epss_options_menu_desc: Extra Profiles and Skill Sets mod options.
epss_total_profiles_desc: Total number of profiles (including base game profiles). Click "Save Settings" to confirm changes.
epss_allow_fewer_desc: Reduce the number of profiles and skill sets to below what is available in the base game.
epss_autobind_skillsets_desc: Each profile will be locked to the corresponding skill set (if not suspended).
epss_number_prefix_desc: Display a number before profile names.
epss_commit_settings_desc: Click to confirm changes to settings, otherwise they will be discarded.
epss_dialog_skill_switch_blocked:
Autobind skill sets is active. Available skill sets are bound to the corresponding profile and cannot be changed.

Disable autobind in the options menu to reassign skill sets manually.
epss_dialog_save_settings_blocked: Settings cannot be changed while playing.
epss_dialog_number_profiles: You have selected $new_num profiles. You currently have $old_num profiles.
epss_dialog_autobind_enable: Autobind skill sets has been enabled. All skill sets will be unlocked and assigned to the corresponding profile when the game is restarted.
epss_dialog_restart: Your game needs to be restarted for changes to take effect. Exit now?
